data.description:
## Problem / opportunity

The process audit initially reported no detection-stage metadata because it queried detected_by:* tags, while the delivered mechanism stores an optional detected_by field. The historical evaluation on unpleasing-hairy-yellowlegs corrected the measurement: 7 of 648 current bugs carry the field (about 1.1%). Provenance capture exists, but coverage is too sparse to calculate escape rate or detection-stage efficiency.

## Prior decision that constrains this idea

commonlaw-cinnamonic-joey rejected another mandatory bug-create or bug-close field because the required close-class rollout had broken automated surfaces and automated filers can stamp low-information constants. evadible-ambitious-canary therefore shipped present-only, optional, fail-open capture at the shared creation seam; unknown tokens remain accepted and history is not retroactively classified. big-mammalian-bronco and cloned-beryl-quokka delivered the surrounding prevention program and metrics lens.

This idea must preserve that zero-friction decision unless new evidence demonstrates that its cost/benefit changed.

## Outcome hypothesis

Known automated filers and agent-session creation boundaries can stamp meaningful detected_by values automatically, producing near-complete provenance for automated creation channels while preserving unprompted, fail-open bug filing.

## Guardrails

- Do not make detected_by globally required or block creation when it is absent or unfamiliar.
- Do not synthesize historical values unless inferred records are explicitly distinguishable from observed values.
- Keep missing as an explicit measurable cohort.
- Measure the field, not a tag convention.
- Attribute the actual detection channel, not merely the transport that persisted the ticket.

## Questions before promotion

- Which creation_channel values and automated filer call sites can supply a truthful detection source?
- What are baseline and target coverage per creation_channel?
- Where should agent-session provenance be injected so CLI, library, and MCP stay consistent?
- Is a documented normalization map needed without enforcing an enum?
- Which bug_trends outputs should distinguish observed, missing, and explicitly inferred cohorts?
- What prospective observation window is sufficient to evaluate the change?

## Evidence

Discovered from unpleasing-hairy-yellowlegs; source audit bleakish-stational-cob. Prior work: commonlaw-cinnamonic-joey, evadible-ambitious-canary, big-mammalian-bronco, cloned-beryl-quokka.
data.title: Expand automated detected_by provenance coverage without filing friction
